name: soundfont

provenance.origin: original work (ABI adapter, host allocator, event mapping, parameters)
provenance.author: smhgzll

provenance.modifications: third_party/patches/tinysoundfont-esp32-daw.patch: the voice render loop in single precision (integer position + float fraction, float pitch ratio with powf once per 64 samples, float low-pass); optional borrowed PCM16 sample pool and direct split stereo output; sample runs without per-sample end tests and a cached envelope step (bit-identical output); a note finding no free voice takes the oldest one when none is in its release

doubleMath: TinySoundFont at note-on (pitch ratio, filter Q: about 20 operations per voice) and twice per voice per block (playback position saved / restored); the per-sample loop is single precision
